name: MWD AI Assistant – Local Lead Generation
author: arashkhalaj

sections.description:
MWD AI Assistant Core works independently with your own OpenAI API account. No MWD account, license, commercial SDK or paid feature implementation is required or included. The optional Upgrade page describes separate products and fetches public prices only after an administrator explicitly clicks.

  • One assistant and one chat engine, with the [mwd_ai_assistant] shortcode and floating widget.
  • Approved public manual answers and public reference links.
  • Appearance, labels, dimensions, language and RTL controls; inherited website fonts.
  • Encrypted provider credentials, atomic safety limits and possession-protected sessions.
  • Paginated history, privacy export/erasure and bounded retention.
  • A shared administration sidebar with AJAX navigation, retained drafts and a floating Save changes button.
  • Conversation cards with complete transcript pagination and selected-conversation erasure.
  • Versioned server and widget contracts for separately installed extensions.

All included functionality is available without payment to MWD. Provider API usage is billed separately to your own provider account. Safety limits are administrator-configured controls, with no paid unlock. No external fonts, tracking or marketing calls run during ordinary bootstrap.

External services

Freemius public prices (optional Upgrade page)

Only clicking View current standalone Pro prices sends a server-side GET to https://api.freemius.com/v1/plugins/38266/pricing.json for published prices. It uses the product public key, not a customer secret. No site account, API key, conversation, email address or license is sent. Freemius receives server IP, product/version and request metadata. Core does not create an account or contact licensing services on bootstrap. Selecting an offer opens https://checkout.freemius.com; a separate checkout confirms the purchase, taxes and renewal terms. No automatic purchase, paid-code download or license activation occurs in Core.

Existing standalone Pro 3.x is incompatible with Core 2.x; the page explicitly discloses this before showing prices. Future compatible add-ons are not included or claimed to be available. Existing license owners should retain their license and verify compatibility rather than buy again.

Terms: https://freemius.com/terms/ — Privacy: https://freemius.com/privacy/

OpenAI

Saving your own key and enabling the assistant authorizes provider requests when visitors send messages. Clicking Test saved provider connection deliberately sends a small test request. The only provider destination in Core is https://api.openai.com/v1/responses. Redirects are disabled.

Chat sends public business instructions, up to five relevant public reference excerpts, up to twelve bounded recent messages, the current visitor message and schemas/results of authorized registered tools. Only the free approved-public-link tool ships in Core. Common email, North American phone and Canadian postal identifiers are masked in visitor/general history text; this is not complete anonymization. Approved manual facts are public by design. Never put secrets in instructions, knowledge or chat.

The API key authenticates server-side and is not included in browser config, HTML, diagnostic exports or model instructions. Requests set store=false; this does not eliminate separate provider abuse-monitoring or other applicable retention. The site operator controls the provider account, billing, applicable consent and privacy notice. A ChatGPT subscription does not include API credits. Model access must be tested with the operator’s account.

  • Service terms: https://openai.com/policies/services-agreement/
  • Privacy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/
  • API data controls: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/your-data

Maple Web Design support

Only explicit submission of the administrator support form sends an email through WordPress mail to info@maplewebdesign.ca. The consent text discloses reply email, site URL, WordPress/Core versions, subject and message. Ordinary chat does not contact Maple Web Design. Documentation is bundled locally; external product links open only when clicked.
sections.installation:
Updating Core 2.0/2.1 to 2.2 preserves Core settings, encrypted keys and data; schema remains 1. The new-storage note below applies to the old 1.x/standalone generation.

  1. Back up before changing an existing site. Core 2.2.1 uses new storage and does not automatically import old settings, training or credentials.
  2. Manually deactivate any old standalone MWD Free copy or Pro 3.x before activating Core. Do not uninstall those packages as an update step. Their existing data and licenses are preserved.
  3. Upload the ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin and activate on the selected site.
  4. Open MWD AI Assistant > Setup, enter your OpenAI API key and save. Leaving the key blank preserves it. OpenSSL AES-256-GCM is required; plaintext fallback is not used.
  5. Test the saved provider connection, add public business instructions and manual answers, and choose a display mode.
  6. Review your privacy policy, choose safety limits and enable the assistant. For inline display add [mwd_ai_assistant] to a Shortcode block or Elementor Shortcode widget.

Network-wide activation is not supported in this release. No network compatibility claim is made. Clear site/page caches after changing enabled state, display or appearance. Server authorization always uses current settings, including for cached pages.
sections.faq:
Why is chat unavailable?

Check enabled state, provider credentials, API account billing, model access and daily safety limits. Diagnostics show redacted categories, not provider bodies. Missing credentials show a setup message. Unknown/incompatible extensions do not replace the base implementation.

How are credentials saved and cleared?

Keys are encrypted with a versioned AES-256-GCM envelope derived from WordPress salts and site context. A blank save preserves the authenticated existing envelope. Clear saved key requires an explicit button. An optional MWDAI_CORE_OPENAI_API_KEY server constant overrides the stored fallback and is managed outside the dashboard. Salt changes require re-entering unreadable keys. Secrets are not exported.

How long are conversations kept?

The default fixed lifetime and retention are seven days, configurable downward to one day. Provider context contains at most twelve recent messages with an additional size bound. Browser session storage holds credentials and revision/expiry only, not transcripts; history is fetched after refresh. Separate shortcode instances use separate sessions. New tabs have independent storage; a browser-duplicated tab may initially copy a session, with revision checks preventing concurrent overwrite. Closing tabs clears session storage according to browser behavior.

Expired conversations are inaccessible even when cron is disabled. Hourly cleanup removes bounded batches and can resume; physical deletion may be delayed while the plugin is inactive, cron is disabled, or backups retain copies. Reset revokes the old session and its proposals while history remains until retention expiry. Erase deletes the current accessible conversation. Administrators can erase a selected conversation. Verified WordPress privacy requests apply to associated logged-in users; typing an email cannot discover anonymous conversations.

How are spending and replay controlled?

Core reserves a conservative upper bound before provider calls, reconciles reported usage, and retains the full charge for uncertain responses until the current daily window rolls over. Provider invoices remain authoritative. Defaults: 500,000 daily text tokens, 12 messages/session/minute and 30/shared-IP/minute; site chat is capped at 120/minute. Session creation is capped at 15/shared-IP/minute and 120/site/minute. NAT visitors share IP limits. Proxy headers are not trusted.

Requests have session-bound IDs and state revisions. Identical replay returns the stored result; changed payload under the same ID is rejected. Mutating extension tools require a short-lived one-use confirmation, current permission and handler reconciliation. AI output never grants authorization. These controls reduce risk and are not a claim of complete security.

What happens on uninstall?

Default is to preserve all Core business data. Explicitly selecting deletion removes only Core-owned options/tables on the current single-site installation. Review extension references before deletion. No legacy options, Freemius accounts/licenses, sibling data or WooCommerce orders are touched. Deactivation removes only Core cron scheduling. No files outside the Core plugin are deleted. Multisite uninstall preserves data.

Where is source code?

All shipped PHP/JS/CSS is readable source, with no compilation required. The developer delivery contains a deterministic Python build script and explicit file allowlist; tests and fixtures are excluded from the installable ZIP. Public update behavior uses the normal WordPress.org channel. This local release has not been published by its build process.
sections.changelog:
2.2.1

  • Fix continuous mouse and touch color selection; preserve keyboard controls.
  • Remove static borders around color swatches.
  • Remove future-product roadmap copy from Upgrade; retain existing offers and compatibility disclosure.

2.2.0

  • Instant administration tabs and visible WordPress submenus; compact floating Save all changes and Discard across drafts.
  • Rounded full-color swatches with HSV palette, pointer/keyboard controls and hex editing.
  • Theme-resistant widget typography, aligned SVG controls and pill launcher; plain-text paragraphs.
  • Concise contextual response policy; sources no longer produce automatic repeated link lists.
  • Optional Upgrade comparison and explicit public-price lookup, with legacy compatibility disclosure. No paid implementations, SDK or licensing forms.
  • Existing API 1.1/schema 1 remain compatible. No automatic legacy migration or deletion.

2.1.0

  • Redesign administration with a left sidebar, AJAX sections and floating save across tabs.
  • Show the saved key immediately using a green field and fixed bullet placeholder; never return the key.
  • Group history by conversation and add complete transcript pagination and selected erasure.
  • Add optional provider model catalogs and shared extension panels in API 1.1; schema stays 1.
  • Retain all free controls, RTL and uninstall choices. No commercial code or upgrade previews are included.

2.0.0

  • Rebuild Free as independent Core, with new owned schema, one engine and versioned extension contracts.
  • Preserve free settings, manual knowledge, recent history, RTL, shortcode/floating modes and approved icons.
  • Add server-bound confirmations, durable request deduplication, conservative usage reservations and private session erasure.
  • Remove catalog/pricing UI and all licensing/account cleanup; no paid implementations are bundled.
  • Require WordPress 6.5; retain PHP 7.4 syntax. Old data is preserved without automatic migration.
  • Use documented Responses model IDs and explicit account connection test.

1.2.9

  • Historical Free baseline with repository contributor arashkhalaj and approved icons.

short_description: A complete BYOK text assistant with manual public knowledge, floating and shortcode widgets, RTL, private sessions and recent history.
